Today's practice: kinder words.
[pause 38]
Imagine a good friend telling you about the same worry you have.
[pause 42]
Notice what you'd say to them. Probably something patient and understanding.
[pause 42]
Now offer yourself those same words, in the same tone.
[pause 42]
You might say: "This is hard, lots of people go through it, and I'm doing my best."
[pause 42]
Take a slow breath, and notice how you feel now compared with when you started.
[pause 41]
Confidence grows with practice, not perfection.
Gently bring some movement back into your body. Notice how you feel now, without needing to change it.
